title: Mongo: replica-set topology
description: Runs `nexus topology mongo`: members + roles + replication state (a replica set is not sharded, so no shard map).

observe.what: node table (hostname/role/status/lag); no shard section (RS is not sharded)

whatProves: MongoAdapter.TopologyAsync renders the RS member graph with Shards=null, distinguishing a replica set from the sharded engines.
